tests.title: Finished tickets are never overdue and don't count toward a limit

bugs.test: an agent cannot take more tickets than their limit
bugs.why: the workload counts only open tickets, so tickets already in progress don't count toward the agent's limit
bugs.fix: Count every unfinished ticket assigned to the agent: status open or in_progress.

bugs.test: a ticket is overdue only after its SLA
bugs.why: the time open is worked out in minutes, not hours, so tickets look overdue far too early
bugs.fix: Divide the milliseconds by 1000 * 60 * 60 (MS_PER_HOUR) to get hours.

bugs.test: tickets are listed by priority, oldest first
bugs.why: tickets with the same priority are listed newest first; the queue must serve the oldest first
bugs.fix: Compare createdAt in ascending order (a before b) as the tie-breaker after priority.

bugs.test: tickets move through the workflow in order
bugs.why: the workflow lets an in-progress ticket jump straight to closed, skipping resolved
bugs.fix: From in_progress the only next status is resolved.
